article.title: Weekly market report: Nifty 50 closes at 25,030.35, up 8.58% this week | 6 November 2026
article.dek: The Nifty 50 ended the week at 25,030.35. NSE index scoreboard, sector heatmap, breadth and institutional flows.

visualSpec.weekLabel: Change from the close on Fri 30 Oct to Fri 6 Nov (NSE)
visualSpec.breadthExchange: NSE, Nifty 500 stocks on the day
visualSpec.fiiDiiNote: NSE provisional figures for the cash market, in ₹ crore.

reportTakeaways: The Nifty 50 ended the week 8.58% higher; the Nifty Next 50 gained 5.83%, the Nifty Midcap 100 gained 5.77% and the Nifty Smallcap 100 gained 2.77%.
Sectors up over the week: Cement, Realty, Consumer durables, Oil & gas, Auto, Private banks, Metal, FMCG, Energy, PSU banks, Pharma, Healthcare, Media, IT.
body: What moved | The Nifty 50 closed the week at 25,030.35, up 8.58% from the previous week's close of 23,053.10 on 30 Oct, and rose 2.01% on the day. Over the week the Nifty Next 50 gained 5.83%, the Nifty Midcap 100 gained 5.77% and the Nifty Smallcap 100 gained 2.77%.
Breadth | On the day 267 stocks in the Nifty 500 fell and 228 rose, according to NSE. India VIX, which measures the volatility traders expect, rose 13.35% to 17.66.
Sectors | Over the week Cement did best (+10.37%) and IT worst (+1.14%) among the sector indices in the heatmap.
Flows | NSE's provisional data show foreign portfolio investors were net buyers of ₹13,749.82 crore in the cash market on the day, and domestic institutions were net sellers of ₹5,968.70 crore.
article.indiaImpact: Index, sector and breadth moves together show how widely gains or losses spread beyond the Nifty 50.
